news.title: Rag Mayur's Anumanam Pakshi suffers heavy box office failure
news.summary: The small-budget release Anumanam Pakshi, starring Rag Mayur and marking Merin Philip's Telugu debut, faced a severe setback at the box office following its September 25 release. Distributed by Chilaka Productions, the movie struggled with negligible audience turnouts and harsh critical reviews from its opening day.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga-backed Romanchakam locks Netflix release
news.summary: The youth-centric romantic comedy Romanchakam is scheduled to make its digital premiere on Netflix on October 1, 2026. Directed by Venu Gopal Reddy and starring Sumanth Prabhas alongside Ananthika Sanilkumar, the film aims to find a broader audience after a subdued theatrical run.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise storms Nizam box office with stellar weekend figures
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise wrapped up its extended opening weekend with an impressive collection of around Rs. 27.5 crore share in the Nizam region alone. Despite facing mixed to negative reviews, the SLV Cinemas production crossed the Rs. 136 crore mark worldwide globally.

news.title: The Paradise shatters records to become Nani's highest-grossing film
news.summary: Headlined by Nani and directed by Srikanth Odela, The Paradise has grossed an astounding Rs. 138 crore globally across its first four days. Despite navigating severe social media trolling and negative feedback, the film crossed the $2 million milestone in North America and surpassed previous lifetime collections in Nani's career.

news.title: Zarina Wahab joins the cast of Puri Jagannadh and Vijay Sethupathi's Slum Dog
news.summary: Veteran actress Zarina Wahab has been officially introduced as Zubaida in the upcoming pan-India action drama Slum Dog, directed by Puri Jagannadh and starring Vijay Sethupathi. The film features a massive multi-industry ensemble cast including Tabu, Samyuktha, and Duniya Vijay. Backed by Puri Connects and JB Motion Pictures, the movie is slated for a multi-lingual release across five languages.

news.title: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's The Vvaan reports growth on Day 2
news.summary: Despite opening to largely negative feedback and disappointing initial reactions, the supernatural folklore drama The Vvaan has reportedly shown collection improvements on its second day. Starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia, the movie amassed a reported worldwide gross of ₹23.5 crore. The makers are banking on the upcoming weekend figures to sustain the momentum.

news.title: Hanuman Ansh crosses ₹400 crore gross mark in historic theatrical run
news.summary: Low-budget feature Hanuman Ansh has achieved a massive box office milestone by surpassing ₹400 crore in global gross collections after 52 days in theatres. Produced on a modest budget of ₹2 crore with an initial opening of just ₹10 lakh, the film has delivered an unprecedented run. Despite missing out on a Telugu distribution deal, the movie continues to post steady numbers internationally.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise defies negative reviews with strong opening weekend numbers
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest release, The Paradise, has defied adverse initial reviews and social media trolling to register impressive box office numbers, particularly in Telangana. Trade analysts project the movie to comfortably clear the ₹150 crore gross threshold during its opening weekend, aided by an extended holiday period. The film's true test will arrive on Monday as regular working days commence.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram Kick Off Musical Promotions for Aadarsha Kutumbam
news.summary: The inaugural single "Narayanamma" from the upcoming film Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.47 – AK47 has been officially unveiled. Composed by Thaman S, the energetic track features a special appearance by Dimple Hayathi alongside lead actors Venkatesh, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is slated for a worldwide release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Surprising Digital Rights Valuation for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War
news.summary: The much-anticipated period drama Love & War, featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal under Sanjay Leela Bhansali's direction, has secured its OTT streaming deal. ZEE5 acquired the digital rights for approximately Rs 25 crore, a figure that has surprised trade analysts given the grand scale of the project. The big-budget Hindi film is scheduled to hit theaters on January 21, 2027.

news.title: Kaasu Promotional Teaser Unveils a Unique Blend of Romance and Obsession
news.summary: A newly released introductory video for the multi-lingual film Kaasu showcases a high-concept narrative driven by attitude, defiance, and the perils of wealth. Veteran producer A.M. Rathnam launched the promotional asset, which highlights the psychological clash between affection and financial temptation. The movie is planned for a grand theatrical rollout across Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi languages.

news.title: Teamwork Defines the Fate of Every Movie
news.summary: Success and failure in the film industry are never driven by a single individual's effort alone. From the writer and director to the actors, technicians, and producer, every craft contributes to a project's outcome. Ultimately, the entire team must shoulder responsibility for a film's results, whether it turns out to be a blockbuster or a disaster.

news.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam Kicks Off Musical Promotions With Narayanamma Single
news.summary: The musical campaign for the Victory Venkatesh starrer Aadarsha Kutumbam - AK47 has officially commenced with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and produced by S. Radha Krishna, the family entertainer features energetic vocals by Ram Miriyala and Prabha alongside music by Thaman S. The vibrant track highlights Dimple Hayati's dynamic dance moves and sets the stage for the film's worldwide theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas Launches Gen-Z Focused Story Reveal for Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Rebel Star Prabhas has unveiled the story reveal video for the upcoming youthful film Romeo Juliet, starring Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman. Directed by Bhargav Mucharla, the movie offers a satirical look at modern romance, situationships, and fickle relationships through an unconventional narrative. The makers opted to share the story preview ahead of its October 23 release to prepare audiences for its unique contemporary theme.

news.title: Unconventional Modern Romance Takes Center Stage in Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Starring Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman, the upcoming youth-centric film Romeo Juliet explores contemporary dating dynamics and modern relationship terminology. Directed by Bhargav Macharla, the story follows a protagonist interacting with a gun dealer in a glimpse that highlights modern romance struggles like situationships and hookups. Backed by producers Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla, the movie is slated to hit theatres on October 23.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Adarsha Kutumbam Unveils First Single Narayanamma
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Venkatesh's upcoming family entertainer Adarsha Kutumbam has officially commenced with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. Composed by S. Thaman with lyrics by Ramajogayya Sastry, the dance track features lead actor Venkatesh alongside Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and produced by Haarika & Hassine Creations, the film is scheduled to hit theaters on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Folk Beats and Star Power Drive Narayanamma Track From Aadarsha Kutumbam
news.summary: Aadarsha Kutumbam has dropped its highly anticipated opening track, Narayanamma, featuring vibrant vocals by Prabha Bangarigalla and Ram Miriyala. The energetic folk-infused number showcases prominent dance sequences by Dimple Hayathi alongside Venkatesh, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie boasts a large ensemble cast and is gearing up for a grand theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Blockbuster Malayalam Rom-Com Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Release
news.summary: The hit Malayalam romantic comedy Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, has officially scheduled its digital premiere on JioHotstar. Directed by Girish AD and produced by Bhavana Studios, the film achieved record-breaking box office milestones during its theatrical run. Viewers can stream the movie starting October 2, 2026, with dubbed audio options available including Telugu.

news.title: Girish AD's Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Sets October Digital Debut on JioHotstar
news.summary: Following a successful theatrical run that began in August, Bethlehem Kudumba Unit is transitioning to digital streaming. The Girish A.D. directorial pairs Nivin Pauly as a thirty-something bachelor with Mamitha Baiju, whose arrival in the neighborhood sparks an unexpected romance. Fans across multiple languages, including Telugu, will be able to watch the blockbuster on JioHotstar starting October 2, 2026.

news.title: Suriya Advises Admirers to Ignore Online Drama
news.summary: During a recent gathering with his fan club members, Tamil actor Suriya encouraged supporters to steer clear of pointless digital feuds. He cautioned them against wasting energy on negative comments and urged everyone to concentrate on personal growth and spreading positivity.

news.title: Can Rajinikanth's Sequel Chase the 1000-Crore Milestone?
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's upcoming action drama Jailer 2 is carrying massive pre-release business expectations as it heads toward an October 15 release. While the first installment was a massive global success, trade analysts are watching closely to see if the sequel can push Tamil cinema into the coveted 1000-crore worldwide club despite mixed early promotional buzz.

news.title: Superstar's 173rd Venture Eyes a Major Festival Slot
news.summary: Rajinikanth's upcoming action venture Dharman is currently targeting a theatrical release for Pongal 2027. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and backed by Kamal Haasan's production banner, the film features a notable cast that includes Ram Pothineni in a key role alongside the legendary lead.

news.title: Speculation Swirls Around Superstar's Next Venture
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu nears the completion of his highly anticipated project Varanasi directed by SS Rajamouli, rumors regarding his next cinematic endeavor have intensified. Recent discussions have linked prominent filmmaker Lokesh Kanagaraj to the actor, though no official casting confirmation has been announced yet.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over 'The Paradise' Dialogue
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently spoke about a controversial dialogue in their latest release, The Paradise, which faced criticism from viewers. The filmmaker clarified that the line was meant to highlight ironic appreciation, but editing out the character's backstory caused the scene to be misunderstood. Meanwhile, the film continues its steady box-office run, heading toward the Rs. 150 crore gross milestone by the end of its opening weekend.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Exhibits Retro Chic in Latest Fashion Shoot
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu recently shared a striking new photoshoot showcasing a vintage-inspired aesthetic with voluminous curls and retro attire. While her recent cinematic outings have faced box-office hurdles, she continues filming for her upcoming project, Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?. Her career choices remain focused on personal fulfillment following past industry hurdles.

news.title: NTR Readies to Join 'Dragon' Mumbai Schedule Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR, who took a temporary break due to a shoulder injury, is preparing to return to the sets of his upcoming film Dragon. Director Prashanth Neel has continued shooting other sequences in the meantime, while a major action-heavy schedule is lined up in Mumbai starting October 10th. The high-profile project features an ensemble cast and is targeting a release next year.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion for 'January 12 Vidudala'
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is fast-tracking his upcoming directorial venture January 12 Vidudala toward a scheduled theatrical release on January 12th. Production will shift to Ooty for a new schedule in early October, with foreign song sequences and remaining portions planned for completion by mid-November. The film features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in pivotal roles.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Introduces A Unique Romantic Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been unveiled in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh, setting up a global theatrical release on October 9. Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the film combines youthful romance with a sudden mystery involving the disappearance of the female lead. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the movie features music by Prince Henry and is backed by High Joy Commercials and VIP – Vintage Iconic Pictures.

news.title: Chakkora Mixes Youthful Romance With Suspense
news.summary: The upcoming romantic drama Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has released its trailer, showcasing a blend of lighthearted romance and intense mystery. Directed by Manga Srinivas and starring Sravan alongside Malaika T. Vasupal, the film follows a carefree young man whose life turns upside down when his love interest vanishes. The project is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Draws Strong Weekend Collections
news.summary: Despite a risky mid-week premiere and mixed initial reviews, Nani's The Paradise has crossed a worldwide gross of 136 crore rupees in its first three days. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film has seen a surge in ticket sales across Telugu states and is nearing the two million dollar mark overseas. The team recently celebrated the project's box office momentum at a success event.
